mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% in the last month
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 5.0%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad economic recovery, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO and HOUST both rise above their 3-month moving averages, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales above pre-recession levels signal consumer demand recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS is above the pre-2020 peak.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls rising above 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises above 200,000 in the last month
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises above 200,000, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 240 signals high inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 240.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal coordinated monetary-labor market stimulus, boosting economic activity and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE declines, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
